besluite.rede: 'Iets in die hande kry' is the idiomatic Afrikaans form, since Afrikaans uses the article with body parts, so the proposal is a lateral move built on a mistaken reason.

besluite.fout: 'kom hitte by brandstof uit' can make a reader stumble in a lesson that uses 'uitkom' for energy coming out (uitset), so it can read as heat coming out of fuel
besluite.rede: 'bereik hitte 'n brandstof' says the same thing (heat gets to the fuel) with no ambiguity and keeps the same people, action and scope.
'hoog op waar klein kinders nie kan bykom nie' is acceptable spoken Afrikaans, and 'hoog op 'n plek' is no smoother, so rewording a fire-prevention rule is not justified.

besluite.fout: 'n Lamp wat lig maak' is wooden next to the natural collocation 'lig gee', and 'lig maak' can also be read as 'make lighter'
besluite.rede: The fault is real, but this is a glossary definition and a word change beyond spelling or grammar, so the writer has to make it.
